data: In the left plot, what is the value of the solid line labeled 'd_f' approximately at the x-axis value of 0.75?

The left plot shows the entrainment profiles for the feature set gnl f0 for proximity. The solid line labeled 'd_f' represents the distance function for feature set gnl f0. To find the approximate value of the solid line labeled 'd_f' at the x-axis value of 0.75, we need to look at the y-axis values corresponding to the intersection of the x-axis value of 0.75 and the solid line labeled 'd_f'. From the figure, the value appears to be around 0.8.
